QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Mission] Defeat 100 Obelisk Guardians
QuestInfo.1: Clementine the Survivalist wants to see if you can live up to your reputation. She has tasked you with capturing the Obelisks found in the Badlands and defeating 100 of the monsters summoned to protect it. \r\n\r\n#b*Obelisks are found throughout the Badlands and can be captured using basic attacks. Monsters will appear to defend the stones.
